announcement_body_description: Supporting line shown next to the heading
announcement_heading_description: Short bold heading, e.g. New Flux version available
announcement_link_text_description: Text of the link at the end of the banner, e.g. Read the release notes
card_background_color_description: Fill colour for panels and cards. Keep this lighter than the page background so they stand out
cp_accent_color_description: Secondary blue, used sparingly for small highlights
cp_action_color_description: The colour of the Raise a case button and other primary actions
cp_action_text_color_description: Text colour used on top of the action colour
cp_action_text_description: Wording on the main button, e.g. Raise a case
cp_action_url_description: Where the main button goes. Leave as /hc/requests/new for the case form
cp_awaiting_labels_description: Comma separated. Cases with these statuses get the strong colour on Your Cases, because the client has to do something. Must match the end user label of the Pending status in Admin Center exactly, so change both together
cp_banner_color_description: Background of the dark banner at the top of the home page
cp_banner_greeting_description: Follows the client's first name, e.g. Hi Pete, welcome to ControlPlane support
cp_banner_greeting_generic_description: Shown instead when the client's name cannot be read
cp_banner_question_description: Second line of the banner, the question that prompts the action
cp_banner_sub_description: The line naming the recommended route, above the button
cp_banner_text_color_description: Text colour used on the dark banner
cp_case_number_label_description: Replaces Zendesk's "Id" label on a case, where the defined term is Case
cp_cases_noun_description: Singular and plural, comma separated. Zendesk writes "1 - 15 of 80 requests" above the table and the word cannot be changed in its settings, so it is swapped in the page
cp_cases_noun_label: Word for a case in Zendesk's own text
cp_cases_tab_ccd_description: Replaces Zendesk's "Requests I am CC'd on" tab label on the cases page
cp_cases_tab_org_description: Replaces Zendesk's "Organisational requests" tab label on the cases page
cp_column_labels_description: Pairs of "the field's customer-facing title=>short name", separated by semicolons. A field has one customer title, which has to work as a question on the form and as a column name here, and a question is too long for a column. Applies to the table headings and the show and hide columns menu, so the two agree
cp_column_labels_label: Short column names for the cases table
cp_deep_blue_color_description: Deep blue, used for the organisation case count and small graphic elements
cp_done_labels_description: Comma separated. Cases with these statuses are shown in grey so they recede
cp_ink_color_description: Near-black used for headings and body text
cp_org_cases_label_description: Label beside the organisation case count
cp_org_cases_sub_description: Smaller line under the organisation cases label
cp_own_cases_count_description: How many of the client's own cases to list on the home page
cp_own_cases_heading_description: Heading above the client's own cases, e.g. Your cases
cp_own_cases_link_text_description: Link under the list that goes to the full list of cases
cp_pale_blue_color_description: Pale blue, used for links inside the dark banner
cp_prepare_text_description: The line asking clients to have their details ready before they start
cp_request_heading_description: Heading on the Raise a case page. Replaces Zendesk's own Submit a request wording
cp_request_intro_description: Short line under the heading, above the form
cp_request_show_sev1_line_description: Show the same Severity 1 phone line that appears on the home page
cp_sev1_alt_text_description: The alternative route offered under the button, worded from the Severity 1 description. The phone number is added from the setting below
cp_severity_field_id_description: ID of the Severity Level ticket field. Leave blank to read severity from the case's own severity tag instead
cp_severity_short_labels_description: Pairs of "start of the option's wording=>short name", separated by semicolons. The cases table is drawn by Zendesk and prints the Severity Level option in full, which is too long for a column. Anything that does not match is left as Zendesk wrote it
cp_severity_short_labels_label: Short Severity names for the cases table
cp_show_browse_topics_description: Show the Browse by topic and promoted articles sections on the home page. Off by default, since Browse topics is in the navigation
cp_show_org_cases_description: Show the count of open cases across the client's organisation on the home page. Off by default: the same list is a tab on the Your cases page
cp_show_own_cases_description: Show the list of the client's own cases on the home page. Their cases are always reachable from Your cases in the navigation
cp_support_phone_description: Phone number shown beside the Severity 1 line
resources_column_title_description: Heading shown above this column's links
resources_heading_description: Heading above both columns of links, e.g. Useful links
resources_link1_url_description: Where link 1 points. Leave blank to hide this link
resources_link2_url_description: Where link 2 points. Leave blank to hide this link
resources_link3_url_description: Where link 3 points. Leave blank to hide this link
resources_link4_url_description: Where link 4 points. Leave blank to hide this link
show_announcement_description: Show the announcement banner at the top of the home page
show_resources_description: Show the project resources links on the home page
show_submit_request_description: Show the Raise a case link in the header navigation
